channel.title: 1000 Errors: Laser Cut Art & Light Sculptures
channel.description: Laser Cut Art & Light Sculptures by 1000 Errors.

item.title: Septagram LED Light Sculpture, Laser Cut Wood Mandala
item.description: Close-up of the Septagram light sculpture's layered star lit in red. Seven-pointed septagram light sculpture in 7 layers of laser cut wood, LED-lit, with a stand and wall hanging ring. 30–80cm. Made in Bristol, UK. Designed and made by 1000 Errors in Bristol, UK.

item.title: Squircles: 3D Printed Shadow Lamp Design
item.description: The lamp hanging over an endless floor at night, casting its bottom cap pattern below it. Squircles, a standalone app for designing 3D printed lamps that cast patterned shadows, which began as a Blender add-on. Designed and made by 1000 Errors in Bristol, UK.

item.title: Layered Laser Cut Beetle Art
item.description: Close-up of the stepped rainbow layers in the 3D preview. Building an app to add three-dimensional depth to beetle paintings with stacked, laser cut layers of card. Designed and made by 1000 Errors in Bristol, UK.

item.title: Sacred Geometry Laser Cut Light Art
item.description: The Lotus Flower of Life lamp in laser cut wood, with an Edison bulb. Sacred geometry light art, laser cut from layered wood and illuminated with LEDs. Designed and made by 1000 Errors in Bristol, UK.

item.title: Lotus Flower of Life Lamp, Laser Cut Wooden Pendant Light
item.description: Lotus Flower of Life wooden lamp hung as a ceiling light above a bookshelf. 3D lotus lamp with the Flower of Life pattern in gold, silver or natural wood. Hangs from the ceiling or stands as a table or floor lamp. 38–115cm wide. Designed and made by 1000 Errors in Bristol, UK.

item.title: Hexstatic LED Light Sculpture, Flower of Life Wood Mandala
item.description: Hexstatic laser cut wooden mandala wall light sculpture glowing magenta. Flower of Life inspired mandala in hexagon layers, laser cut from birch, hand painted and lit with adjustable LEDs. 35–70cm. Made in Bristol, UK. Designed and made by 1000 Errors in Bristol, UK.
